text:
maria (sales): Heads-up: new POC request from a pan-EU payments customer. They want: SIG/CAIQ, explicit DPA & SCC mapping, a dataflow showing EU-only processing for PII, full subprocessor roster with region column, and confirmation on KMS/HSM options. Deadline: next Wed COB. Who can pick this up?
drew (security): I can own the SIG/CAIQ and DPA writeup. Need to know whether they require Processor binding in-EU only or allow subprocessors outside EU under SCCs. Also need the formal deletion SLA they want.
sam (solutions): We should outline three deployment options in the packet: 1) Hosted (eu-west-1) with keywrap to customer KMS, 2) Dedicated in customer VPC with BYOK + HSM option, 3) Private (on-prem) for full HSM. I'll produce a short comparison matrix.
zoe (product): I'll pull the latest CAIQ-derived answers and flag controls that are conditional on deployment mode. Note: network egress logging and telemetry vendor are listed as subprocessors in prod; we'll provide region mappings.
maria (sales): Customer specifically asked that logs, traces and any backups stay in EU for the POC and want a step showing how we purge test artifacts after POC.
drew (security): We'll provide: - annotated CAIQ with conditional notes - subprocessor CSV with region column and contract links - deletion checklist + commands - KMS options doc. Also will add standard backup rotation + snapshot retention language.
sam (solutions): Quick ascii dataflow to include in the first email (keeps it lightweight):
```
User(EU) -> CDN (edge) -> ALB (eu) -> Router -> Inference Pool (eu GPUs)
                             -> KV cache (ephemeral, eu)
Inference -> Audit Log (PII-filter) -> Object Storage (eu-only)
Inference -> Metrics (scrubbed) -> Monitoring (eu)
Post-POC -> Purge job -> DB snapshots delete && S3 lifecycle expire
KMS: optional customer KMS (keywrap) <-> model nodes
```
maria (sales): Nice. Can we include exact example commands for the purge? They want to hand to ops.
sam (solutions): Sure, sample s3 lifecycle + db snapshot purge snippet I'll add:```bash
# purge objects with prefix poc-test/ older than 1 day
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-logs-eu/poc-test/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include 'poc-test/*'
# delete snapshot
aws rds delete-db-snapshot --db-snapshot-identifier poc-snapshot-2026-03-01
```
drew (security): Add note: we redact IPs/usernames from metrics before exporting to third-party monitoring. If they require zero-export, we can route metrics to their monitoring endpoint in their VPC for Dedicated.
zoe (product): I've uploaded the CAIQ draft and the current subproc export. Please annotate any special POC-only subprocessors.
terra-bot: terra-bot uploaded file: /internal/artifacts/caij-answers-2026-03-22.pdf
terra-bot: terra-bot uploaded file: /internal/artifacts/subprocessors-eu-2026-03-22.csv
drew (security): For the subprocessor CSV I'll add columns: name, role, data types processed, regions, contract link, breach-notify SLA. We'll mark prod vs poc-only.
maria (sales): Procurement already pinged me for a cost estimate if they choose Dedicated (2x A10 for 4 weeks). I'll handle pricing DM. Keep thread focused on security artifacts.
sam (solutions): I'll assemble the packet: 1) annotated CAIQ 2) subprocessor CSV 3) ascii + PNG dataflow 4) purge checklist + commands 5) KMS options note. I can have drafts by EOD tomorrow.
drew (security): I'll add deletion SLA language: "POC data purged within 7 days of POC end; backups rotated and any snapshots deleted within 14 days" as default; we can adjust if they need shorter window.
maria (sales): Solid. Once we have artifacts I'll upload to their secure portal. Also planning to ask for a short addendum to the NDA for subprocessor disclosure.
zoe (product): One more: confirm whether they want CAIQ responses signed by security; if so I can prepare a short cover letter for signature.
maria (sales): Yes — they'll likely request the signed attestation. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
